head: 3477d064da8541451840959c419b94146b185053
title: feat: Critical-Path Scheduler v1 (PR #107)
body: Introduce Critical-Path Scheduler v1: parallelize test and review stages on implementation completion bound to an immutable candidate SHA, and evaluate multi-dependency join gates deterministically.

head: 2b9f2177fa15446e8d5fd5bce0d95d82e41342ac
title: feat: Selective Replan v1 (explicit task-targeted fix-loop)
body: Introduce Selective Replan v1: narrow fix-loop invalidations to implementation tasks explicitly targeted by structured gate blockers instead of re-running the entire implementation stage.

head: 7709da70c2c395806f3df8359899d229786ab843
title: feat: Selective Reverification v1 (PR #108)
body: Introduce Selective Reverification v1: allow verifiers to reuse previous passing verification results across candidate revisions when changes are outside the declared impact scope.
